messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick alert — Novatek hosted spend alarm fired at 02:47 UTC. 4.1M tokens in ~6h, 95p latency +180ms, and 5xx rate ~1.6%. Health job flagged it.
Ethan (DataOps): Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/novatek/health. Ran a quick query: 
```
SELECT api_key, endpoint, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as calls
FROM api_logs
WHERE customer='novatek' AND ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY api_key, endpoint
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Top line: key classify-01 -> 3.7M tokens, endpoint `/v1/embeddings`. Pattern starts ~22:30 UTC. :mag_right:
Ravi (Support): Logs show mostly 429 then 502 from our side. Sample lines: 
```
[22:35:11] id=aa11 path=/v1/embeddings status=429 reason=rate_limit_exceeded
[22:36:03] id=bb22 path=/v1/embeddings status=502 runtime_memory_pressure
```
Lina (Billing): If this burn continues we're projected to exceed weekly commit by tomorrow morning. Suggest we enable a protective throttle and notify sales for potential top-up. :warning:
Maya (CSM): I reached out to Julia (novatek). Julia replied: "we kicked off a batch job last night for email classification that streams an embedding per document. We'll pause and check batching."
Ethan (DataOps): Two quick hypotheses: (1) client batching dropped to size 1 after a SDK change; (2) a retry loop from their ingestion pipeline. Also check whether they flipped off our client-side caching.
Maya (CSM): Action items: 
- Ethan: provide per-key call histogram and time series for last 8h (ETA 25m)
- Ravi: grab 5 representative request IDs and escalate if 5xx persists (ETA 10m)
- Lina: prepare soft-cap at 75% of weekly commit + warning template (ETA 20m)
- Maya: coordinate with Julia and hold high-level notice until we confirm root cause (I'll do 1:30 PDT sync)
Ethan (DataOps): quick snapshot: `classify-01 -> 3.7M tokens / 41k calls; ingest-rt -> 220k tokens`. Looks like one key is dominant.
Ravi (Support): Escalating to eng-runtime, creating ticket ENG-7901 with trace IDs and sample payloads. Flagged for oncall.
eng-runtime-bot: Anomaly ticket ENG-7901 created, assigned to @eng-runtime-oncall. Notifying eng-runtime channel.
Julia (Novatek): we paused the job and rolling back to previous SDK. Will confirm whether batching was changed. Thanks for the quick catch.
Lina (Billing): I've set a soft cap at 75% of weekly commit on classify-01 and enabled an early warning email (warn then hold). Cap is active. Projected burn with cap: +8% this week vs commit (safe).
Ethan (DataOps): Recommended mitigations for Novatek: re-enable batched requests, client-side prefix caching, and add exponential backoff to retries. Also consider our server-side quantized fallback if runtime errors continue. I'll draft a short mitigation note for Maya to share.
Maya (CSM): I'll run the 13:30 PDT check-in with Julia and close loop here afterwards. If 5xxs or tokens spike again after cap, tag @Maya and escalate to Sales for commit increase conversation.
eng-runtime-oncall: Acknowledged ENG-7901. Monitoring runtime memory and kv cache pressure, will report within 30m.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — keep updates in this thread. If Julia confirms client fix and metrics normalize we'll close. Otherwise we'll set up a postmortem and renewal-impact assessment.
